results.question: For client A12353, which meetings raised that part of the income arrives in dollars while costs are paid in local money?
results.answer:
Three of the 23 meetings in scope for client A12353 have a text match, and each says currency exposure is significant, with about 30% of revenues denominated in USD but expenses largely local. Each also says a hedging policy and scenario P&L were requested:

- Meeting 19047, 2024-01-07 (company NorthStar FO). Action items not recorded. [meeting: 19047, 2024-01-07]
- Meeting 19238, 2025-02-24 (company BlueOak Partners). Action items recorded: a one-page summary of operational fixes, and introducing legal counsel to draft a shareholder agreement within 10 business days. [meeting: 19238, 2025-02-24]
- Meeting 7568, 2025-03-06 (company GreenField Ventures). Action item recorded: share detailed sensitivity tables. [meeting: 7568, 2025-03-06]

The other 17 meetings shown were retrieved by semantic similarity only, and none of their retrieved sentences states this point. One (meeting 11707, 2025-10-31) mentions hedging alternatives in connection with seasonal cash-flow, which is a different topic. [meeting: 11707, 2025-10-31]

Three of the 23 meetings in scope were not shown, since 20 were listed. I can't say whether they raise this point.
